title: Channel user roles, account delegation and capability decisions
workflow: Validate identity token origin and intended audience
Resolve institution, channel and exact account/resource ownership
Apply relevant customer, joint mandate and corporate approval scope
Check account restrictions and allowed current product capabilities
Require step-up or additional signer where risk policy demands
Record decision ID without disclosing confidential screening results
invariants: Hidden UI control does not count as a permission check
Backend must reject cross-tenant object references and IDs
User/account/mandate approval evaluated at request time, not just login
An active role cannot override an expired corporate signing mandate
Policy version is reproducible for forensic audit
Read account scope does not automatically grant transfer authority
Delegation must be revocable and effective-dated
acceptance_tests: Stale role token cannot elevate privileges
Risk step-up challenge persists until satisfied
independent_gate: Legal mandate rules, IAM role/permission contract and executable IDOR and privilege-abuse tests.
